## 0.4.7

- Top apps on the Overview page now show each app's icon.
- Cleaner Rewrite text. Plain punctuation (no curly quotes or stray semicolons), spoken asides in brackets, your own casual words kept, "um" and "uh" removed, and quick corrections like "Claude, sorry, ChatGPT" now keep only the fix.
- A Licences page in Settings credits the speech models and the open-source software Dicta uses.
